title: Design System: Marqel Etsy Edge Instrument

components.name: Page Dock
components.description: A compact task, Web and settings launcher without analysis shortcuts.

components.name: Capability Passport
components.description: Page, authority, runtime and next-action facts with a textual reason.

components.name: Execution Rail
components.description: Web approval, lease preflight, field fill and terminal readback.

components.name: Task Evidence Action
components.description: User-triggered privacy-safe evidence capture bound to the active task.

components.name: Node Verdict
components.description: The strongest Node Console object and current safe-action statement.

components.name: Single Settings View
components.description: Device identity, runtime version, site scope and hard boundaries only.

narrative.overview: A narrow browser instrument for one approved Etsy task, one visible page and one verifiable result.
keyCharacteristics: Small page footprint and visible recovery
dos: Show exact task identity before mutation
Disable repeat mutation after uncertain readback
donts: Do not add competitor or trend analysis
Do not add local model credentials
Do not imply a click is business completion
